(rule!
  (let ((n (rows g)))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([cell (in-list (grid-cells g))])
      (let ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)) (v (third cell)))
        (if (not (= v 0))
            (set-cell out (- n 1 c) (- n 1 r) v)
            out)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define copied ((lambda (g) (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))) (let ((n (rows g)))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([cell (in-list (grid-cells g))])
      (let ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)) (v (third cell)))
        (if (not (= v 0))
            (set-cell out (- n 1 c) (- n 1 r) v)
            out)))))) g))
  (define objs (objects-8 copied 0))
  (if (null? objs)
      copied
      (let ((winner (pick-max objs obj-size)))
        (paint-cells copied (obj-cells winner) 4)))))
